title: NewsNation slide showing a DOE gravity-propulsion patient
summary: Jesse Michels tells of NewsNation slide showing a DOE gravity-propulsion patient, about recent at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a slide from a report by NewsNation, an American cable news channel. He says the slide shows a patient with what he calls a kind of white matter syndrome, an injury to the brain's connecting tissue, and the story ties this patient to secret gravity-propulsion work at the Department of Energy, the US government agency that runs nuclear and energy research. Michels connects it to the journalist Ross Coulthart and the researcher Eric Weinstein. If true, it would mean people near that hidden work were physically harmed by it.
